title: DBFlux redesign: New site: variants and Ember
brief: Imported from Claude.ai artifact RrT5VLW14vaPQzV1ab71hT: Explorations, row "New site: variants and Ember".

artboards.title: V1 Restrained: amber only for actions
artboards.tradeoff: Restrained site: minimal color and decoration; easy to read, easy to forget.

artboards.title: V2 Paper: light, ink band
artboards.tradeoff: Paper site: light, print-like and calm; quiet, weaker brand presence.

artboards.title: V3 Electric: blue accent, amber only in the mark
artboards.tradeoff: Electric site: saturated accents and high energy; eye-catching, tiring on long pages.

artboards.title: Ember: full site
artboards.tradeoff: Ember site: warm editorial serif; inviting, less technical.

artboards.title: V4 Byzantium: #702963
artboards.tradeoff: Byzantium site: deep color and strong contrast; the most distinctive, the least neutral.
